incidents.short_description: Polar Arc TK9 exports in degF after firmware 4.2.1
incidents.description: From 20 Oct 2026 Polar Arc TK9 Pro loggers (fw 4.2.1) export readings in degF at a 10-minute interval; the CSV column is 'reading' with no unit. The unit is in <logger>_meta.json. Boundary records can repeat in two segments. Fleet register (Sept export) still shows degC/15 min - to be updated.
